Task: issue #7006 — enable COVERAGE_CORE=sysmon where merge_group shards collect coverage.

Context: #6989 deliberately moved coverage collection to merge_group (pre-merge floor enforcement — keep that). Measured cost: uniform +~35% on all four pytest shards (queue 15.8 → 21.8-22.4 min, confirmed on a solo quiet-queue run). We run coverage==7.14.1, Python 3.12.8, LINE coverage only — the exact configuration where the sys.monitoring backend is near-free.

Steps:
1. In .github/workflows/ci.yml, set COVERAGE_CORE: sysmon in the env of every step that can run pytest with --cov (the shard step; check whether fastlane/coverage-combine also execute --cov and treat them the same). Do NOT touch the COLLECT_COVERAGE conditions — the merge_group enforcement design stays.
2. EQUIVALENCE PROOF (#M-4): locally run a small representative test subset twice with --cov=scripts — once default core, once COVERAGE_CORE=sysmon — and quote both coverage totals; they must match (±rounding). Also quote the wall-clock of both runs to show the overhead delta.
3. actionlint ci.yml; run the three workflow-contract tests (tests/test_frontend_change_scope.py tests/test_paths_filter_fail_open.py tests/test_workflow_head_concurrency.py) and quote output.
4. Branch cursor/infra-7006-sysmon, conventional commit (Fixes #7006), push, open PR. NO auto-merge — driver reviews; the real measurement lands with the PR's own merge_group run.
